en.hubeali:
From him, from one of his companions, 
(It has been narrated) raising it to Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘
Sweeping the house negates the poverty’.
en.sarwar: 8. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from certain persons of his people in a marfu‘ manner has said the following: “Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Sweep the house, it removes poverty.’”
